title: The Tuesday Club
description: Walk through 1890s Chicago as Rosa and follow one girls' club at Hull House from its first meeting to its goodbye. The game pauses three times for group activities.
players: Groups of 4, one phone per pair
concept: Social group work: what makes a group, stages of group development, social goals model (Ch. 5)

title: Term Duel
description: Rock-paper-scissors your way around the room: win and name a term, lose and explain it. Tick off every term on your own phone.
concept: Course vocabulary: What Makes a Group; Group Stages & Social Goals; Community Work

title: Storm Over Clear Creek
description: You doze off in a hard English lecture, a typhoon cuts the power, and you wake up in a mountain village. Watch the need-based path fail, discuss, then rewind and guide the social worker down the asset-based path. Pick the wrong response and it's Game Over. Needs a password from your teacher.
players: Played in class: solo on a phone, a pair on one phone, or a pair on the projector with an 8BitDo
concept: Community work: NBCD vs. ABCD, cycle of dependency, community principles, Rothman's three models, PARK, practice steps
